candidate_decisions.reason: The ten nominated branches land in the same pericope relation: attempted removal from the earth, drowning, the post-removal dwelling command, and a later mixed gathering. The claims remain bounded to the focus addressees and do not identify them with Pharaoh's retinue.

The 17:97 indexed gathering and resurrection-day surfaces meet the focus bringing and mixed-company words. The terminal-muster reading survives as an attributed contextual parallel, while the possible difference in referents remains explicit.

The indexed debris, raising, renewed creation, and fixed-term surfaces in 17:98-99 contact the focus promise, bringing, and mixed company. The reconstitution reading is retained with the historical-regathering alternative intact.

The exact 17:100 ownership and withholding occurrences meet the focus's command to inhabit the earth and its later bringing. The resulting distinction between residence and title remains a qualified inference, not a legal ruling.

Every traced 17:103 surface matches its supplied root and word index, and the focus returns through afterness, dwelling, and bringing. The counter-displacement relation is retained with the chronology-only alternative visible.

The 17:106 division, gradual delivery, and waiting traces contact the focus interval and mixed gathering. This yields an exploratory staged-interval reading; the text may describe recitation alone, and the weak reciprocal connection is retained as qualification.

The supplied 17:107-108 bodily response and enacted-promise occurrences meet the focus's saying, promise, and bringing. The speech-to-event reading survives as attributed context, without treating the response as a mechanism proving how the final gathering occurs.

The focus promise's supplied harvest branch meets 17:106's indexed division into portions and the focus mixed company. It survives as an exploratory material analogy, never as a direct gloss of the ordinary promise sense.

findings.title: From attempted removal to settled residence
findings.claim: The ruler's attempt to unsettle the people from the earth ends in his drowning; the following command to dwell on that same earth makes the settlement a reversal of the movement he sought, while a later appointed gathering remains the focus's endpoint.
findings.mechanism: The context's intention and destabilizing expulsion meet the focus earth, afterness, and imperative to dwell; drowning removes the would-be displacer, and the focus arrival, appointed time, and mixed-company words carry the sequence forward into a later collective event.
findings.reader_payoff: The settlement reads as a change in who directs the people's movement, not simply as a new place to live.
findings.containment: The mixed company is the focus's addressed group; the text does not make it identical to Pharaoh and his retinue. The reversal does not establish permanent land title or a particular date for the later appointment.

epistemic.reason: The exact 17:103 Arabic and focus QAC occurrences directly support the attempted expulsion, drowning, same-earth reference, and dwelling command; the cited channel support is trusted and the claim stays at that surface.

findings.title: A counter-decree after attempted displacement

findings.mechanism: The same land is first the object of expulsion and then the place of habitation. The context's destabilizing attempt and total drowning meet the focus's temporal afterness, stilling command, and bringing; the focus speech and imperative also make the settlement an exercise of authority. Spatial distance from the removed ruler and inward security remain qualified contextual echoes.
findings.reader_payoff: The command reads as an answer to a failed attempt at uprooting, carrying both restored physical stability and a bounded echo of security.
findings.containment: The word after him can remain a chronological link, and the final divine bringing may be independent of the expulsion scene. The focus does not grant permanent ownership; inward security is a contextual effect, not a direct substitute for the command to inhabit.

epistemic.reason: The exact 17:103 roots and focus QAC carriers align with the traced roles. The principal reversal is direct in the sequence, while HFT identity is legacy_unbound and the added distance and security readings are bounded contextual inferences.
